features.quote: Maximum: 20 turns. A 'turn' is one complete agent action (tool call + result).
The run ends when: 1. The agent hits turn 20, OR 2. The agent emits a give_up() signal
Keeping run counts proportionate (don't run 10,000 runs of this)
features.justification_quote: We don't know enough about model experience to be confident there's nothing there, and deliberately inducing conditions that produce distress-coded outputs warrants at least some thought.
